```{=html}
<!-- ── Load RELAX engine ────────────────────────────────────────── -->
<script src="../js/relax-embed.bundle.js"></script>

<!-- ── Styles ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── -->
<style>
/* ── Layout ── */
#relax-app {
  font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif;
  max-width: 1100px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0 4px;
}

/* ── Panels ── */
.rx-panel {
  border: 1px solid #dee2e6;
  border-radius: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
  background: #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.06);
}
.rx-panel-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 10px 16px;
  background: #1e3a5f;
  border-radius: 8px 8px 0 0;
  color: #fff;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 0.92em;
  letter-spacing: .03em;
}
.rx-panel-body { padding: 14px 16px; }

/* ── Textareas ── */
.rx-textarea {
  width: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  font-family: 'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 0.84em;
  border: 1px solid #ced4da;
  border-radius: 5px;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  resize: vertical;
  background: #fafafa;
  color: #212529;
  line-height: 1.55;
  transition: border-color .15s;
}
.rx-textarea:focus {
  outline: none;
  border-color: #4a90d9;
  background: #fff;
}

/* ── Symbol toolbar ── */
#rx-symbols {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 5px;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  background: #f0f4fa;
  border-radius: 6px;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}
.rx-sym-group {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 4px;
  padding-right: 10px;
  border-right: 1px solid #c8d8ef;
  margin-right: 4px;
}
.rx-sym-group:last-child { border-right: none; }
.rx-sym-label {
  font-size: 0.68em;
  color: #6c757d;
  width: 100%;
  margin-bottom: 2px;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: .04em;
}
.rx-sym-btn {
  background: #fff;
  border: 1px solid #b8cce8;
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 3px 9px;
  font-size: 1em;
  cursor: pointer;
  color: #1e3a5f;
  font-family: 'SFMono-Regular', monospace;
  transition: background .12s, border-color .12s;
  line-height: 1.4;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.rx-sym-btn:hover {
  background: #1e3a5f;
  color: #fff;
  border-color: #1e3a5f;
}
.rx-sym-btn:active {
  background: #0d2540;
  color: #fff;
}

/* ── Toolbar row (run + clear) ── */
.rx-toolbar {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-top: 8px;
}
.rx-btn {
  padding: 7px 22px;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 5px;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 0.88em;
  font-weight: 600;
  transition: background .15s;
}
.rx-btn-run {
  background: #1d7f3f;
  color: #fff;
}
.rx-btn-run:hover { background: #165f2e; }
.rx-btn-clear {
  background: #6c757d;
  color: #fff;
}
.rx-btn-clear:hover { background: #5a6268; }
.rx-btn-copy {
  background: #1976d2;
  color: #fff;
}
.rx-btn-copy:hover { background: #1256a3; }

/* ── Schema selector dropdown ── */
.rx-schema-select {
  background: #2a4a7f;
  color: #fff;
  border: 1px solid #4a6fa5;
  border-radius: 5px;
  padding: 4px 10px;
  font-size: .82em;
  cursor: pointer;
  outline: none;
}
.rx-schema-select:focus { border-color: #90caf9; }

/* ── ER Diagram ── */
.er-diagram {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 20px;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: flex-start;
  padding: 4px;
}
.er-table {
  border: 2px solid #1e3a5f;
  border-radius: 8px;
  overflow: hidden;
  min-width: 160px;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.1);
  flex: 0 0 auto;
}
.er-table-head {
  background: #1e3a5f;
  color: #fff;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 0.88em;
  padding: 7px 12px;
  letter-spacing: .04em;
  text-align: center;
}
.er-table-head.leaf { background: #1a5c3a; }
.er-col {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 4px 10px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #eee;
  font-size: 0.8em;
  font-family: 'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, monospace;
  background: #fff;
}
.er-col:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
.er-col-pk {
  background: #fff8e1;
  font-weight: 700;
}
.er-col-fk { background: #e8f4fd; }
.er-badge {
  font-size: .68em;
  padding: 1px 5px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: .03em;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.er-pk { background: #ffd54f; color: #5d4037; }
.er-fk { background: #81d4fa; color: #01579b; }
.er-col-name { flex: 1; }
.er-col-type { color: #888; font-size: .85em; }
.er-rel-note {
  font-size: .75em;
  color: #6c757d;
  padding: 6px 10px;
  background: #f0f4fa;
  border-top: 1px dashed #c0cfe8;
  text-align: center;
  font-style: italic;
}

/* ── Results area ── */
#rx-results { display: none; }
.rx-results-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 16px;
}

/* ── Table ── */
.rx-table-wrap {
  overflow-x: auto;
  max-height: 420px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  border: 1px solid #dee2e6;
  border-radius: 5px;
}
.rx-table {
  border-collapse: collapse;
  font-size: 0.82em;
  width: 100%;
}
.rx-table thead { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 1; }
.rx-table th {
  background: #1e3a5f;
  color: #fff;
  padding: 7px 10px;
  text-align: left;
  white-space: nowrap;
  font-weight: 600;
}
.rx-table th small {
  font-weight: 400;
  opacity: .75;
  font-size: .8em;
  display: block;
}
.rx-table td {
  padding: 5px 10px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #f0f0f0;
  font-family: 'SFMono-Regular', monospace;
  font-size: .92em;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.rx-table tbody tr:hover { background: #f0f4fa; }
.rx-meta {
  font-size: 0.8em;
  color: #6c757d;
  margin-top: 6px;
  padding: 4px 6px;
  border-left: 3px solid #1e3a5f;
}
.rx-error {
  color: #c0392b;
  background: #fdecea;
  border: 1px solid #e57373;
  border-radius: 5px;
  padding: 10px 14px;
  font-size: 0.87em;
  font-family: 'SFMono-Regular', monospace;
  white-space: pre-wrap;
}

.rx-formula {
  background: #0d1b2e;
  border: 1px solid #2a4a7f;
  border-radius: 7px;
  padding: 12px 18px;
  font-size: 1.05em;
  overflow-x: auto;
  margin-bottom: 0;
  color: #e8eaf6;
  letter-spacing: .01em;
  line-height: 2;
  min-height: 2.4em;
}
/* Style the RELAX-generated math spans */
.rx-formula .math { font-style: italic; font-weight: 700; color: #82b1ff; font-size: 1.1em; }
.rx-formula sub   { font-size: 0.78em; color: #b2ebf2; vertical-align: sub; }
.rx-formula span  { display: inline; }

/* ── Expression tree ── */
.rx-tree-wrap {
  border: 1px solid #dee2e6;
  border-radius: 5px;
  background: #fafbff;
  min-height: 80px;
  /* overflow visible so hover popups can escape the box */
  overflow: visible;
  position: relative;
}
.rx-tree-scroll {
  overflow: auto;
  max-height: 480px;
  padding: 16px;
}
.ra-tree {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
}
/* Classic ul/li CSS tree with connector lines */
.ra-tree ul {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 16px 0 0 0;
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: nowrap;
  gap: 0;
}
/* Vertical line from parent down to the horizontal bar */
.ra-tree ul::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0; left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  width: 2px;
  height: 16px;
  background: #8ab0d8;
}
.ra-tree li {
  list-style: none;
  padding: 0 10px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  position: relative;
}
/* Horizontal connecting line above siblings */
.ra-tree li::before,
.ra-tree li::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0; right: 50%;
  border-top: 2px solid #8ab0d8;
  width: 50%;
  height: 0;
}
.ra-tree li::after { right: auto; left: 50%; }
.ra-tree li:first-child::before,
.ra-tree li:last-child::after { border-top: none; }
.ra-tree li:only-child::before,
.ra-tree li:only-child::after { display: none; }
/* Vertical line from horizontal bar to node */
.ra-tree li > .ra-node-wrap::before {
  content: '';
  display: block;
  width: 2px;
  height: 16px;
  background: #8ab0d8;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.ra-node-wrap { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; position: relative; }
.ra-node-box {
  background: linear-gradient(145deg, #1e3a5f, #2c5282);
  color: #fff;
  padding: 7px 14px 6px;
  border-radius: 7px;
  font-family: 'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, monospace;
  font-size: 0.82em;
  white-space: nowrap;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.2);
  text-align: center;
  min-width: 80px;
  cursor: default;
  position: relative;
}
.ra-node-box.leaf {
  background: linear-gradient(145deg, #1a5c3a, #2d8555);
}
.ra-node-box .math { font-style: italic; }
/* Row count badge shown below the operator label */
.ra-node-rows {
  display: block;
  font-family: 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
  font-size: 0.78em;
  font-weight: 400;
  opacity: .82;
  margin-top: 3px;
  letter-spacing: .01em;
}
/* Hover popup — fixed position (escapes all overflow/scroll boundaries) */
.ra-node-popup {
  display: none;
  position: fixed;
  z-index: 99999;
  background: #1a2035;
  color: #e8eaf6;
  border: 1px solid #3a4a7a;
  border-radius: 7px;
  padding: 10px 14px;
  min-width: 230px;
  max-width: 360px;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.55);
  font-family: 'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, monospace;
  font-size: 0.78em;
  line-height: 1.7;
  white-space: nowrap;
  pointer-events: none;
  /* arrow is drawn via JS as a pseudo – use border trick on a span */
}
.ra-node-popup .pop-title {
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: .9em;
  color: #90caf9;
  margin-bottom: 5px;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.ra-node-popup .pop-col {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 16px;
}
.ra-node-popup .pop-col-name { color: #e0e0e0; }
.ra-node-popup .pop-col-type { color: #80cbc4; opacity: .85; }
</style>

<!-- ── App HTML ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── -->
<div id="relax-app">

  <!-- Schema selector + editor -->
  <div class="rx-panel">
    <div class="rx-panel-head">
      <span>📋 Schema Definition</span>
      <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;">
        <select id="rx-schema-select" class="rx-schema-select" onchange="rxSelectSchema(this.value)">
          <option value="company">🏢 Enhanced Company DB</option>
          <option value="university">🎓 University DB</option>
          <option value="ecommerce">🛒 E-Commerce DB</option>
          <option value="hospital">🏥 Hospital DB</option>
          <option value="library">📚 Library DB</option>
        </select>
        <button class="rx-btn rx-btn-copy" style="padding:4px 12px;font-size:.78em;"
          onclick="rxCopySchema()">Copy Schema</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="rx-panel-body">
      <textarea id="rx-schema" class="rx-textarea" rows="8"
        spellcheck="false" autocomplete="off"
        placeholder="Define your tables here using inline-relation syntax..."></textarea>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ER Diagram panel -->
  <div class="rx-panel" id="rx-er-panel">
    <div class="rx-panel-head"><span id="rx-er-title">🗺️ ER Diagram</span></div>
    <div class="rx-panel-body" style="padding:16px;">
      <div id="rx-er-diagram"></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Query editor -->
  <div class="rx-panel">
    <div class="rx-panel-head">
      <span>⚙️ Query Editor</span>
    </div>
    <div class="rx-panel-body">

      <!-- Symbol toolbar -->
      <div id="rx-symbols">

        <div class="rx-sym-group">
          <div class="rx-sym-label">RA Ops</div>
          <button class="rx-sym-btn" title="Projection"     onclick="rxInsert('π ')">π</button>
          <button class="rx-sym-btn" title="Selection"      onclick="rxInsert('σ ')">σ</button>
          <button class="rx-sym-btn" title="Rename"         onclick="rxInsert('ρ ')">ρ</button>
          <button class="rx-sym-btn" title="Order by (τ)"   onclick="rxInsert('τ ')">τ</button>
          <button class="rx-sym-btn" title="Group by (γ)"   onclick="rxInsert('γ ')">γ</button>
        </div>

        <div class="rx-sym-group">
          <div class="rx-sym-label">Assign</div>
          <button class="rx-sym-btn" title="Left arrow ←"   onclick="rxInsert(' ← ')">←</button>
          <button class="rx-sym-btn" title="Right arrow →"  onclick="rxInsert(' → ')">→</button>
        </div>

        <div class="rx-sym-group">
          <div class="rx-sym-label">Logic</div>
          <button class="rx-sym-btn" title="And (∧)"        onclick="rxInsert(' ∧ ')">∧</button>
          <button class="rx-sym-btn" title="Or (∨)"         onclick="rxInsert(' ∨ ')">∨</button>
          <button class="rx-sym-btn" title="Not (¬)"        onclick="rxInsert('¬')">¬</button>
        </div>

        <div class="rx-sym-group">
          <div class="rx-sym-label">Compare</div>
          <button class="rx-sym-btn" title="Equals"         onclick="rxInsert(' = ')"> = </button>
          <button class="rx-sym-btn" title="Not equal (≠)"  onclick="rxInsert(' ≠ ')">≠</button>
          <button class="rx-sym-btn" title="Greater-eq (≥)" onclick="rxInsert(' ≥ ')">≥</button>
          <button class="rx-sym-btn" title="Less-eq (≤)"    onclick="rxInsert(' ≤ ')">≤</button>
        </div>

        <div class="rx-sym-group">
          <div class="rx-sym-label">Set</div>
          <button class="rx-sym-btn" title="Intersection (∩)" onclick="rxInsert(' ∩ ')">∩</button>
          <button class="rx-sym-btn" title="Union (∪)"        onclick="rxInsert(' ∪ ')">∪</button>
          <button class="rx-sym-btn" title="Division (÷)"     onclick="rxInsert(' ÷ ')">÷</button>
          <button class="rx-sym-btn" title="Difference (-)"   onclick="rxInsert(' - ')">-</button>
        </div>

        <div class="rx-sym-group">
          <div class="rx-sym-label">Join</div>
          <button class="rx-sym-btn" title="Natural join (⨝)"      onclick="rxInsert(' ⨝ ')">⨝</button>
          <button class="rx-sym-btn" title="Left outer join (⟕)"   onclick="rxInsert(' ⟕ ')">⟕</button>
          <button class="rx-sym-btn" title="Right outer join (⟖)"  onclick="rxInsert(' ⟖ ')">⟖</button>
          <button class="rx-sym-btn" title="Full outer join (⟗)"   onclick="rxInsert(' ⟗ ')">⟗</button>
          <button class="rx-sym-btn" title="Left semi-join (⋉)"    onclick="rxInsert(' ⋉ ')">⋉</button>
          <button class="rx-sym-btn" title="Right semi-join (⋊)"   onclick="rxInsert(' ⋊ ')">⋊</button>
          <button class="rx-sym-btn" title="Anti-join (▷)"         onclick="rxInsert(' ▷ ')">▷</button>
          <button class="rx-sym-btn" title="Cross product (⨯)"     onclick="rxInsert(' ⨯ ')">⨯</button>
        </div>

        <div class="rx-sym-group">
          <div class="rx-sym-label">Misc</div>
          <button class="rx-sym-btn" title="Comment (--)"    onclick="rxInsert('-- ')">--</button>
          <button class="rx-sym-btn" title="Divide (/)"      onclick="rxInsert('/')"> / </button>
          <button class="rx-sym-btn" title="Multiply (*)"    onclick="rxInsert('*')"> * </button>
          <button class="rx-sym-btn" title="Open brace"      onclick="rxInsert('{')">{ </button>
          <button class="rx-sym-btn" title="Close brace"     onclick="rxInsert('}')"> }</button>
        </div>

      </div><!-- end #rx-symbols -->

      <textarea id="rx-query" class="rx-textarea" rows="4"
        spellcheck="false" autocomplete="off"
        placeholder="Enter a relational algebra expression, e.g.:  σ Salary > 65000 (Employee)"></textarea>

      <div class="rx-toolbar">
        <button class="rx-btn rx-btn-run" onclick="rxRun()">▶ Execute</button>
        <button class="rx-btn rx-btn-clear" onclick="rxClear()">✕ Clear</button>
        <span id="rx-status" style="font-size:.8em;color:#6c757d;margin-left:6px;"></span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Results -->
  <div id="rx-results">

    <!-- Formula bar (KaTeX-rendered expression) -->
    <div class="rx-panel">
      <div class="rx-panel-head"><span>∫ Expression</span></div>
      <div class="rx-panel-body" style="padding:10px 16px;">
        <div class="rx-formula" id="rx-formula-bar"></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Expression tree — full width row -->
    <div class="rx-panel">
      <div class="rx-panel-head"><span>🌳 Expression Tree</span></div>
      <div class="rx-panel-body" style="padding:10px;">
        <div id="rx-tree-area" class="rx-tree-wrap"><div class="rx-tree-scroll" id="rx-tree-scroll"></div></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Result table — full width row -->
    <div class="rx-panel">
      <div class="rx-panel-head"><span>📊 Result Table</span></div>
      <div class="rx-panel-body" style="padding:10px;">
        <div id="rx-table-area"></div>
        <div id="rx-meta" class="rx-meta"></div>
      </div>
    </div>

  </div><!-- end #rx-results -->

</div><!-- end #relax-app -->

<!-- ── JavaScript ───────────────────────────────────────────────── -->

  ];

  /* ── 5. Library Database ── */
  SCHEMAS['library'] = {};

  SCHEMAS['library'].er = [
    { name: 'Member', pk: 'Mem_id', fk: {},
      cols: [['Mem_id','string'],['Fname','string'],['Lname','string'],['Email','string'],['Phone','string'],['Join_date','string'],['Status','string']] },
    { name: 'Author', pk: 'Aid', fk: {},
      cols: [['Aid','string'],['Fname','string'],['Lname','string'],['Country','string']] },
    { name: 'Book', pk: 'Bid', fk: {},
      cols: [['Bid','string'],['Title','string'],['ISBN','string'],['Year','number'],['Publisher','string'],['Category','string'],['Copies','number']] },
    { name: 'Book_Author', pk: null, fk: { Bid: 'Book.Bid', Aid: 'Author.Aid' },
      cols: [['Bid','string'],['Aid','string']] },
    { name: 'Loan', pk: 'Lid', fk: { Mem_id: 'Member.Mem_id', Bid: 'Book.Bid' },
      cols: [['Lid','string'],['Mem_id','string'],['Bid','string'],['Loan_date','string'],['Due_date','string'],['Return_date','string']] },
    { name: 'Fine', pk: 'Fid', fk: { Lid: 'Loan.Lid' },
      cols: [['Fid','string'],['Lid','string'],['Amount','number'],['Paid','string']] },
  ];

  /* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     ER DIAGRAM RENDERER
     ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  function renderER(tables) {
    let html = '<div class="er-diagram">';
    for (const t of tables) {
      const fkSet = new Set(Object.keys(t.fk || {}));
      html += `<div class="er-table">`;
      html += `<div class="er-table-head${t.pk ? '' : ' leaf'}">${escHtml(t.name)}</div>`;
      for (const [col, type] of t.cols) {
        const isPK = col === t.pk;
        const isFK = fkSet.has(col);
        let cls = 'er-col';
        if (isPK) cls += ' er-col-pk';
        else if (isFK) cls += ' er-col-fk';
        let badges = '';
        if (isPK) badges += '<span class="er-badge er-pk">PK</span>';
        if (isFK) badges += `<span class="er-badge er-fk" title="→ ${escHtml(t.fk[col])}">FK</span>`;
        html += `<div class="${cls}">${badges}<span class="er-col-name">${escHtml(col)}</span><span class="er-col-type">${escHtml(type)}</span></div>`;
      }
      // FK legend
      const fkEntries = Object.entries(t.fk || {});
      if (fkEntries.length > 0) {
        const notes = fkEntries.map(([c,ref]) => `${escHtml(c)} → ${escHtml(ref)}`).join(' &nbsp;|&nbsp; ');
        html += `<div class="er-rel-note">${notes}</div>`;
      }
      html += `</div>`;
    }
    html += '</div>';
    return html;
  }

  function escHtml(s) {
    return String(s||'').replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;');
  }

  /* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     DOM REFS
     ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  const schemaEl  = document.getElementById('rx-schema');
  const queryEl   = document.getElementById('rx-query');
  const resultsEl = document.getElementById('rx-results');
  const tableArea = document.getElementById('rx-table-area');
  const metaEl    = document.getElementById('rx-meta');
  const treeArea  = document.getElementById('rx-tree-scroll');
  const formulaEl = document.getElementById('rx-formula-bar');
  const statusEl  = document.getElementById('rx-status');
  const erPanel   = document.getElementById('rx-er-panel');
  const erTitle   = document.getElementById('rx-er-title');
  const erArea    = document.getElementById('rx-er-diagram');

  /* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     SCHEMA SELECTOR
     ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  window.rxSelectSchema = function (key) {
    const s = SCHEMAS[key];
    if (!s) return;
    schemaEl.value = s.schema;
    erTitle.textContent = '🗺️ ER Diagram — ' + s.name;
    erArea.innerHTML = renderER(s.er);
    // hide results from previous run
    resultsEl.style.display = 'none';
    statusEl.textContent = '';
    queryEl.value = '';
  };

  /* Load company schema by default */
  rxSelectSchema('company');

  /* ── Insert symbol at cursor in query textarea ── */
  window.rxInsert = function (sym) {
    const ta = queryEl;
    ta.focus();
    const start = ta.selectionStart;
    const end   = ta.selectionEnd;
    const before = ta.value.substring(0, start);
    const after  = ta.value.substring(end);
    ta.value = before + sym + after;
    const pos = start + sym.length;
    ta.setSelectionRange(pos, pos);
  };

  /* ── Copy schema ── */
  window.rxCopySchema = function () {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(schemaEl.value).then(() => {
      statusEl.textContent = '✓ Schema copied!';
      setTimeout(() => { statusEl.textContent = ''; }, 2000);
    });
  };

  /* ── Clear ── */
  window.rxClear = function () {
    queryEl.value = '';
    resultsEl.style.display = 'none';
    statusEl.textContent = '';
    queryEl.focus();
  };

  /* ── Shared fixed-position popup (one DOM element, moved on hover) ── */
  const _popup = document.createElement('div');
  _popup.className = 'ra-node-popup';
  document.body.appendChild(_popup);

  function showPopup(nodeData, boxEl) {
    if (!nodeData.columns || nodeData.columns.length === 0) return;
    const colRows = nodeData.columns.map(c =>
      `<div class="pop-col"><span class="pop-col-name">${escapeHtml(c.name)}</span><span class="pop-col-type">${escapeHtml(c.type)}</span></div>`
    ).join('');
    _popup.innerHTML =
      `<div class="pop-title">Schema &nbsp;·&nbsp; ${nodeData.columns.length} col${nodeData.columns.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}, ${nodeData.rowCount >= 0 ? nodeData.rowCount + ' rows' : '?'}</div>` + colRows;
    _popup.style.display = 'block';
    positionPopup(boxEl);
  }

  function positionPopup(boxEl) {
    const r = boxEl.getBoundingClientRect();
    const pw = _popup.offsetWidth  || 240;
    const ph = _popup.offsetHeight || 100;
    // Try above; fall back to below if not enough room
    let top = r.top - ph - 10;
    if (top < 8) top = r.bottom + 10;
    let left = r.left + r.width / 2 - pw / 2;
    left = Math.max(8, Math.min(left, window.innerWidth - pw - 8));
    _popup.style.top  = top  + 'px';
    _popup.style.left = left + 'px';
  }

  function hidePopup() { _popup.style.display = 'none'; }

  /* ── Build tree HTML — store node data on DOM elements for hover ── */
  function buildTreeHtml(node) {
    const isLeaf = !node.children || node.children.length === 0;
    const cls    = isLeaf ? 'ra-node-box leaf' : 'ra-node-box';
    const rowBadge = node.rowCount >= 0
      ? `<span class="ra-node-rows">${node.rowCount} row${node.rowCount !== 1 ? 's' : ''}</span>`
      : '';
    let html = `<li><div class="ra-node-wrap">`;
    html += `<div class="${cls}" data-has-schema="1">${node.htmlLabel}${rowBadge}</div>`;
    if (!isLeaf) {
      html += `<ul>`;
      for (const child of node.children) html += buildTreeHtml(child);
      html += `</ul>`;
    }
    html += `</div></li>`;
    return html;
  }

  /* After injecting tree HTML, attach mouse events with node data captured in closures */
  function attachTreeEvents(rootEl, treeNode) {
    // Walk rendered DOM in parallel with treeNode structure
    function attach(liEl, node) {
      const box = liEl.querySelector(':scope > .ra-node-wrap > .ra-node-box');
      if (box && node.columns && node.columns.length > 0) {
        box.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => showPopup(node, box));
        box.addEventListener('mouseleave', hidePopup);
      }
      const ul = liEl.querySelector(':scope > .ra-node-wrap > ul');
      if (ul && node.children) {
        const lis = ul.querySelectorAll(':scope > li');
        node.children.forEach((child, i) => { if (lis[i]) attach(lis[i], child); });
      }
    }
    const rootLi = rootEl.querySelector('ul > li');
    if (rootLi) attach(rootLi, treeNode);
  }

  /* ── KaTeX formula renderer ── */
  function renderFormula(htmlFromRelax) {
    // The RELAX engine emits spans like:
    //   <span class="math">σ</span><sub>condition</sub>…
    // We want to show this nicely. KaTeX is already on the page via Quarto.
    // Strategy: keep the HTML as-is but style it nicely; strip outer parens at root.
    const cleaned = htmlFromRelax
      .replace(/^\s*\(\s*/,'').replace(/\s*\)\s*$/,'')   // strip outermost parens
      .replace(/\t/g,' ');
    formulaEl.innerHTML = cleaned;
  }

  /* ── Execute ── */
  window.rxRun = function () {
    const schema = schemaEl.value.trim();
    const query  = queryEl.value.trim();
    if (!schema) { statusEl.textContent = '⚠ Schema is empty.'; return; }
    if (!query)  { statusEl.textContent = '⚠ Query is empty.';  return; }

    if (!window.relaxAPI) {
      statusEl.textContent = '⚠ RELAX engine not loaded yet. Try again in a moment.';
      return;
    }

    statusEl.textContent = '⏳ Running…';
    resultsEl.style.display = 'none';
    hidePopup();

    setTimeout(function () {
      try {
        const group = window.relaxAPI.relaxParseGroup(schema);
        if (group.error) { showError('Schema parse error:\n' + group.error); return; }
        const result = window.relaxAPI.relaxExec(group, query);
        if (result.error) { showError('Query error:\n' + result.error); return; }

        /* ── Formula bar ── */
        renderFormula(result.formulaHtml || '');

        /* ── Expression tree ── */
        if (result.tree) {
          treeArea.innerHTML = `<div class="ra-tree"><ul>${buildTreeHtml(result.tree)}</ul></div>`;
          attachTreeEvents(treeArea, result.tree);
        } else {
          treeArea.innerHTML = '<em style="color:#6c757d">No tree available.</em>';
        }

        /* ── Result table ── */
        if (result.columns.length === 0) {
          tableArea.innerHTML = '<em style="color:#6c757d">Empty result (0 columns).</em>';
        } else {
          let thead = '<thead><tr>';
          for (const col of result.columns) {
            // split "Table.col" for two-line header
            const dotIdx = col.name.indexOf('.');
            const relPart  = dotIdx >= 0 ? col.name.substring(0, dotIdx) : '';
            const namePart = dotIdx >= 0 ? col.name.substring(dotIdx + 1) : col.name;
            thead += `<th>${escapeHtml(namePart)}${relPart ? `<small style="opacity:.55">${escapeHtml(relPart)}</small>` : ''}<small>${escapeHtml(col.type)}</small></th>`;
          }
          thead += '</tr></thead>';
          let tbody = '<tbody>';
          for (const row of result.rows) {
            tbody += '<tr>';
            for (const cell of row) {
              tbody += `<td>${cell === null ? '<em style="opacity:.5">null</em>' : escapeHtml(String(cell))}</td>`;
            }
            tbody += '</tr>';
          }
          tbody += '</tbody>';
          tableArea.innerHTML = `<div class="rx-table-wrap"><table class="rx-table">${thead}${tbody}</table></div>`;
        }
        metaEl.textContent = `Degree: ${result.columns.length}   |   Rows: ${result.rowCount}`;

        resultsEl.style.display = 'block';
        statusEl.textContent = `✓ Done — ${result.rowCount} row${result.rowCount !== 1 ? 's' : ''}`;
        resultsEl.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });

      } catch (ex) {
        showError('Unexpected error:\n' + (ex.message || String(ex)));
      }
    }, 10);
  };

  function showError(msg) {
    formulaEl.innerHTML = '';
    treeArea.innerHTML  = '';
    tableArea.innerHTML = `<div class="rx-error">${escapeHtml(msg)}</div>`;
    metaEl.textContent  = '';
    resultsEl.style.display = 'block';
    statusEl.textContent = '✗ Error';
  }

  function escapeHtml(s) {
    return String(s)
      .replace(/&/g,'&amp;')
      .replace(/</g,'&lt;')
      .replace(/>/g,'&gt;')
      .replace(/"/g,'&quot;');
  }

  /* ── Ctrl+Enter shortcut ── */
  queryEl.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key === 'Enter') {
      e.preventDefault();
      rxRun();
    }
  });

})();
</script>
```

## How to Use

Use the **Schema Definition** textarea to define your tables using inline-relation syntax, then type a relational algebra expression in the **Query Editor** and click **▶ Execute** (or press **Ctrl+Enter**).

### Quick Reference — Symbol Bar

| Group | Symbols | Meaning |
|-------|---------|---------|
| **RA Ops** | `π` `σ` `ρ` `τ` `γ` | Projection, Selection, Rename, Order-by, Group-by |
| **Assign** | `←` `→` | Assignment arrows |
| **Logic** | `∧` `∨` `¬` | And, Or, Not |
| **Compare** | `=` `≠` `≥` `≤` | Equality and inequalities |
| **Set** | `∩` `∪` `÷` `-` | Intersection, Union, Division, Difference |
| **Join** | `⨝` `⟕` `⟖` `⟗` `⋉` `⋊` `▷` `⨯` | Natural/outer/semi/anti/cross joins |
| **Misc** | `--` `/` `*` `{` `}` | Comment, arithmetic, grouping |

### Example Queries

Try these on the pre-loaded **Enhanced Company Database**:

```text
-- Select high-salary employees
σ Salary > 65000 (Employee)

-- Project only names and salary
π Fname, Lname, Salary (Employee)

-- Natural join employee with their assignments
Employee ⨝ Works_On

-- Left outer join (keep all employees, null if no assignment)
Employee ⟕ Works_On

-- Employees who are also managers (intersection by SSN)
π Ssn (Employee) ∩ π Mgr_ssn (Department)

-- Employees working on any project in Department 1
π Fname, Lname (σ Dnum = 1 (Employee ⨝ Works_On ⨝ Project))

-- Rename relation and column
ρ Emp ← π Ssn, Fname, Salary (Employee)
```
